entities.name: Duskana
entities.description: Bear of Ravnica who appears seemingly from nowhere and inspires bestial rage, always seen with her three cubs.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Region where Duskana was first spotted.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: Summoner whose failed rite produced Duskana.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: Faction whose prophecy speaks of a pale bear.

events.summary: Duskana is first spotted roaming the Rubblebelt after a failed summoning rite by Yarus.
events.quote: First spotted roaming the Rubblebelt after a failed summoning rite by Yarus
